",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Bo. I drive a Granary truck. If you came for the story, sit down. Most do.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What happened near the Burnt Convoy?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Are you a killer?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why did you sign the patrol roll?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Tell me about the swivel.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where is Jens buried?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},"ev","str","^What of Jens's brother?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The Vosk brothers had been stopping trucks on the Nose road for a while. They always knew which ones. We carried a Brann swivel, and I had never fired at a man.","
","^They came out of the wreck rows. I swung the ring and I fired. Jens went down in the road.","
","^I stopped the truck. I went back to him. He was already gone.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^The tenant hall sat on it. They said a tenant who defends his load is not a killer. They were kind.","
","^I sat quiet. The hall can say what it likes. I know what my hand did.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^For the vote, mostly. Years yet to serve. I would be lying to say it was only that.","
","^A man on the road with a rifle should be a man who has thought about it. I have thought about it every night since.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Otto Brann's mount, from Ridge Wrecks. A ring of hull plate that swings across the bed. It locks with a pin.","
","^After that day Otto came and put a second pin on every swivel he had made. He did not say why. He did not need to.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Brother Anselm put him in the ground by Canyon Bridge. Across the road from Hal Sorensen, who died at the same trouble years before. Anselm lies there too now, between them.","
","^Lusa Fenwick reads their names at the bridge once a year. I go. I stay for all of it.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Never caught. Some say he hid among the squatters at the convoy. Some say he rides for Kiln. I do not ask.","
","^If he came to my truck I would give him the grain and I would give him water. I would give him anything that bought Jens his life back.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

Bucket down, ears open."," ",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Heard any rumors?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Seen any strangers come through?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Any local legends?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you make of Nose?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why does every truck carry a gun now?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},"ev","str","^What about the glass at the Glass Flats?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},"ev","str","^Is it true the Sunward take strangers?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":4},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},{"c-0":[" ","^Funny you ask. A scavenger came through a few days back, trying to sell a Nose Army radio. Said he pulled it off an Army wagon sitting dead in the hills north-east of here. When the Farmers asked him where, exactly, he filled his tank and left for Nose in a hurry."," ","ev","str","^wagonBowl","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev"," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":[" ","^Every day. Traders, couriers, folk with a tank of fuel and a story. The ones that worry me are the quiet ones who ask where the seed stores are."," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":[" ","^You know Glass Flats, out east? There is an Old World tank out there that still runs. Rolls out at night with its lights off. My cousin saw it. Well. Heard it."," ","ev","str","^glassTank","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev"," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":[" ","^Soldiers playing at a town. They eat our grain and send us orders back. Polite enough, mind you, whenever they want something."," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":[" ","^Pierce will not insure one without. The Granary arms its trucks. The Senate lets even tenants carry. And any welder can cut a mount from hull plate in a day."," ","^Ridge Wrecks does the finest, I hear. Otto Brann signs each one. A signed gun, think of that. Folk used to sign a loaf."," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":[" ","^Pim Arslan, the lens cutter, says every ripple in it leans one way. Toward the Fallen Sun. My cousin says it points at heaven. He drinks."," ","^Sun or heaven, I will not stand on it at noon."," ","ev","str","^talkGlassLean","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev"," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":[" ","^They say a stranger goes into the crater with the Sunward and does not come out. I say people come out of the crater green at the edges and quiet."," ","^I have never followed one in. {"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Jory Baptiste. I speak for the tenants, which is to say I talk and the Senate nods off. Sit. The stool is free, which is more than the vote is.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are the tenants?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^How does a tenant get a vote?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why do you fill the patrol with tenants?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Does the patrol trouble you?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you make of Kiln and the grain?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},"ev","str","^Is it true the top terraces draw water in secret?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you make of Nose?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who is Bo Lindqvist?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The ones who grow it. The citizens eat it. You can tell us apart by the dirt under the nails.","
","^We own less than Nose folk and answer to fewer. Poor but loose, like a dog off the chain.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Serve in the Bowl road patrol for a decade. Then the Senate lets you drop a pebble in a jar. My grandfather died one season short. Bad timing, but he was always a man of his own schedule.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Because the Senate wrote the rule, and I read it back to them slowly. They said service earns a vote. I send them the service.","
","^They let tenants carry rifles on the road now, and pay half the cost on grain runs. Nobody asked what a rifle in a tenant's hands might mean come voting day.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^They searched my house at night once. Looking for a rifle, they said. They found a spoon. I told them to keep it, I have more.","
","^They know my face now. Good. A man should be known by somebody.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^We pay Kiln and we pay the patrol, and we pay both with the same grain. A fine trick. The sack leaves once and the Senate counts it twice.","
","^Odile Marsh keeps the Granary count and writes it on the gate. Go read it. Both lines are our grain.","
","ev","str","^talkGranaryGate","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Say that in the market and they send for a meter. I will say it here. A pipe, they say, from the seep up to the top terraces. No meter allowed to read it.","
","^Have I seen it? I have seen the top terraces. Their kitchen gardens are very green for a dry year.","
","ev","str","^talkSeepPipe","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^They ration everyone and call it kindness. A fed man in a line is still in a line.","
","^Ask me again in a famine. I may change my mind. I may not. I am a stubborn fellow when I am hungry.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^A tenant who drives for the Granary. First of us to sign the patrol roll. Gentle as a tired ox.","
","^Do not joke with him about Jens Vosk. I joke about everything else, but I know where the edge is.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

Water runs downhill, and so do people. Folk came for the canals and stayed for the seed."," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":[" ","^The canal families. Every gate has a family, and every family has a say. It is a slow way to decide things, but nobody ever starved waiting on a quick answer. The Farmers keep the roads for us."," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":[" ","^My grandmother said the whole basin was orchards, wall to wall, and the canals ran full in every season. Then the sky fell and the fruit went with it. She never could agree with herself on which came first."," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":[" ","^A ship, they say, bigger than Bowl. It came down burning and dug that crater. Some say it brought the end with it. I say the end was already here, and the ship just landed on top of it."," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":[" ","^You have stood in that crater, then. You tell me. Nose calls it a warship. ","^Something warm runs into your eye. One high note rings in your ears. The world swims.","

","^Dust drifts across the hood. The other truck idles close, its driver a shape behind a screen.","

","^Grain from the Granary to wherever the Senate points. Every truck carries a gun now, on a ring pinned twice.","
","^The Granary pays a sack for each armed truck that crosses Kiln's road. A sack is cheaper than a truck.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Odile Marsh's counts. Sacks to Kiln. Tenants' shares for the patrol. She was a tenant once, and some of us still call her a turncoat behind her back.","
","^She counts every sack at night, twice. I have watched her. She does not blink.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Only the road near the walls. The Nose will not pay for the rest, and keeps its own. Between us there is nobody.","
","^So every truck is its own patrol. That is why we all carry a gun.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^I trust them to be Kiln. Pay and they let you through. Fight hard and they often let you through. Do neither and they strip you.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Convoy drivers say there are towns past the canyon where trucks carry no guns. A guard paid by every town keeps the roads, they say.","
","^Lusa Fenwick rode west with a convoy and came back with the tale. She is a dreamer. I have not been west. Neither has anyone who swears it.","
","ev","str","^talkWestTowns","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^My uncle was. Soldiers came to the Orchard gate at night after it ended and were turned back. Some of them are on my crew now. Hungry soldiers make fine drivers.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Good drivers. They sit at the back of the hall, and they do not complain. I have seen worse men with a vote.","

",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What does the Bureau do?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who writes the gate law?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Tell me about Emil Kessel.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Did a Pierce clerk go missing?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you carry to the Pierce office?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},"ev","str","^What about the depot business?","/str",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^open","/str","!=","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":4},{"c-0":["

",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["

","^Constance Pierce. Head underwriter at this office. Augustin Pierce was my great-grandfather, and I do not use his name as a key. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^An unarmed driver loses his load, and we pay. An armed driver keeps it, or at least makes it dear. I wrote the rule. It is arithmetic. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^A mount with a single pin can slide on a bend. The gun comes round into the cab, and we pay for a driver and a truck. Now we insure only a mount pinned twice. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^We write no paper on a Nose mount with one pin. Nose drivers pay the Salvage Yard to bore the second. That is not my doing, and I do not stop it. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^The Army left and nobody took its place. The rifles went loose, and the road went open. A policy needs a thing to insure, and an armed truck is one. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^I do not say it is a good world. I say it is the one that pays its debts. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["

facts.text: North bend: Emil's wreck is bare. The ring under the gun was torched off at the base. The bolts still stand in the bed.

facts.name: yard_tally
facts.text: Yard tally: a Nose steel ring, torch cut, bought as scrap the week Emil died. Sold on to a Kiln hauler.

facts.name: otto_read
facts.text: Otto: a Nose ring carries the gate stamp on its flat and a single pin hole. A Brann ring has a small mark and a second pin.

facts.name: saw_roster
facts.text: Crane office: Captain Silver's patrol roster lies in a drawer, copied twice in one small hand. The corner of one copy says M. Kessel.

facts.name: has_ring
facts.text: Kiln: the ring with the gate stamp and a single pin hole. Bought from a rider.

",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are you?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why do you write everything twice?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why does every truck here carry a gun?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^What happened to your brother?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Do you know someone at the Pierce office?","/str",{"VAR?":"pin_fate"},"str","^mara","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Constance Pierce has proof against her cousin.","/str",{"VAR?":"crates_fate"},"str","^proof","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^You look like someone with a problem.","/str",{"VAR?":"pin_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^I was an inspector of the Order Bureau. Now I count patrols for Captain Silver. Nose calls that a posting. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^A page can be lost. A page and its copy must both be lost. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^The Army left, and nobody patrols the open road. Each town guards its own walls and no more. Pierce insures only armed trucks, so the gun became the price of a policy. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^Nose hands out a mount with the gate pass. I do not say it is a good mount. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Emil drove the north road for Nose. The bend took him last winter. His swivel slid and the gun came round into his cab. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^The mount had one pin. The line issued it that way with his gate pass. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Constance Pierce reads every file that crosses her desk, and none of them twice by accident. If you go to her, ask her who read my old case. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Then the Pierce board has my old case with another name on it. Fine. A true thing wears many names. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^I want the gun mount from Emil's wreck. The wreck lay on the north road for a season, and strippers got there first. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^Bring me the mount. It is Nose steel, and it has one pin. I need to hold it in my hands. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",["ev","str","^I will find it.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not my road.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^pinAsk","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Thank you. Tell nobody at the post. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","

",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Sefa Krol. I trade for the families of the Burnt Convoy. Show me what you carry and I will tell you what it is worth. Keep your hand off my table.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are the families of the Burnt Convoy?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you sell here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why do you never take the last water?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Is the Burnt Convoy picked clean?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^What is it with the debtor book?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},"ev","str","^What is your deal with Kiln?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},"ev","str","^Did you hide a robber once?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you make of Pierce and the guns?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you make of the post at the gate?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":4},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^People who live where the road stopped. We are not a camp. A camp has a flag and a man who wants to be called sir.","
","^We are first to any wreck, and last to leave it. That is all we are.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^What the road is done with. Wiring, wheel rims, a gun with no pin. Things that have a second life if you are not proud.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^A man with no water is a body, and a body is trouble. Leave him his water and he is a fool who walks on. Fools talk less than bodies.","
","^Also, my mother would find out. She finds out everything.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Who says that? Ibo says it, on the air, to men who would not drive out there for a gift. Good. Let him.","
","^We pick it every week and the road leaves more. Rust grows new things. Ask any family.","
","ev","str","^talkConvoyNotClean","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^We stopped a Pierce office truck on the road and took a book off the seat. Page after page of names and sums. Sums I cannot read, the zeroes go on so long.","
","^The Yard could read them. I sold it to them. What it says is not for sale, and what the Yard does with it is not my business.","
","^A crane office has a shut door now, and a shut door is a loud thing.","
","ev","str","^talkCraneBook","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Kiln has a man named Kaplan who knows a fair split. What Kiln riders leave on the road is ours. What we find of their dead we bury with their boots on.","
","^It is a good arrangement. Nobody on either side likes it, which is how you know it works.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Men come to the convoy with nothing. We ask nothing. One came after his brother died in the road. He ate our beans for a long time and spoke little. Then he went south.","
","^I will not say his name. It would be rude to the beans.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^I hear that Pierce sold the Old Army's guns north to Scrapjaw, and then made every driver buy a gun to get paper. I hear it from a pair of drivers who each swear the other lied.","
","^Good business, if it is true. A man who sells the fire and the bucket never starves.","
","ev","str","^talkPierceGuns","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Nose soldiers inside a free yard. Mara Kessel writes down who comes and goes. She writes it twice. A woman who writes twice is afraid of something.","
","^We keep to the north side. Soldiers do not like the wind there.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

","^Keeping the Yard safe for honest haulers. The crews cannot hold the gate against raiders. My soldiers can. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Nose wants nothing the Yard does not already owe it. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Because the Army is gone and nobody patrols the road. Each town guards its own walls. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
","^Nose lets no truck out of its gate without a gun, and the line gives it a mount with the pass. A truck that leaves unarmed is a gift to the raiders. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^It is steel. It swings. It locks. A driver who knows his mount does not have trouble with it. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["

","^A post cannot run on talk. Move him off the bend. How you do it is your business. I pay well. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
